text: Kyle Lukoff's Call Me Max was removed from classrooms by the Palm Beach County school district for further review, with the district citing House Bill 1557. On March 31, 2022, a Deputy Superintendent emailed principals that the book was being reviewed and should be moved where students could not access it during the review period.
